label: App Port
description: BYOA: port the customer's app listens on inside its container (default 3000). Copied onto the Provisioning Job at enqueue, alongside source_code.

label: Terminal Access Approved At
description: Stamped by staff via the AdminInbox "Approve Developer Access" action. Required (alongside terminal_disclosure_accepted_at) before a terminal session can be minted — being on an Enterprise plan alone is not sufficient.

label: Terminal Access Approved By
description: Staff email that approved developer terminal access, for audit.

label: Terminal Disclosure Accepted At
description: Customer's one-time acceptance of the developer-terminal disclosure (network/session-recording notice). Never client-settable except via POST /api/portal/terminal/accept-disclosure, which stamps this from the server clock.

label: Resource Admin Approved At
description: Stamped by staff via POST /api/admin/web-accounts/:webAccount/resource-admin/approve. Required (alongside resource_admin_disclosure_accepted_at and a Business+ plan) before the customer can edit environment variables or read runtime logs for their own resource.

label: Resource Admin Approved By
description: Staff email that approved resource-admin access, for audit.

label: Resource Admin Disclosure Accepted At
description: Customer's one-time acceptance of the resource-admin disclosure (you can break your own service; support scope changes). Never client-settable except via POST /api/portal/resource-admin/accept-disclosure, which stamps this from the server clock.

label: Email Verified
description: Set to 1 by GET /api/auth/verify-email once the account clicks its verification link (routes/authRoutes.js). requireAdmin (server.js) now REQUIRES this to be truthy in addition to an ADMIN_EMAILS match -- an unverified inbox can never pass admin auth, even if the email matches. IMPORTANT: this field is unset (0) on every EXISTING row when first installed -- there is no automatic backfill and no self-service re-verification path for an account that predates this feature, so every current admin must be flipped to 1 by hand in Frappe Desk (Web Account list -> open the row -> check Email Verified -> save) as part of deploying this change, or they lock themselves out of the admin panel. See docs/production-env-setup.md.
